are_you_ok.title: Emergency fishing salvage ordered at Westminster lake
are_you_ok.summary: Colorado Parks and Wildlife has removed fishing limits at McKay Lake in Westminster, a suburb between Boulder and Denver, to save fish from drought conditions, urging locals to participate with a valid license.
questions: Are the lakes near you dropping like that too?
Has the drought changed anything about your summer?

conversation_starters.title: Steve Lacy, Fuerza Regida announce autumn Red Rocks concerts
conversation_starters.summary: Steve Lacy and Fuerza Regida are set to heat up Red Rocks Amphitheatre — the open-air venue built into the rocks in the foothills west of Denver, roughly 40 miles south of Boulder — this November, as the iconic venue continues to expand its star-studded 2026 lineup.
questions: Do you get out to Red Rocks much?
Is there anything on this year's lineup you're trying to see?
conversation_starters.description: Steve Lacy and Fuerza Regida are set to heat up Red Rocks Amphitheatre this November, as the iconic venue continues to expand its star-studded 2026 lineup.

conversation_starters.title: Deputy breaks van window to rescue dog in 80-degree heat
questions: Did you see the deputy who broke a window to get a dog out of a hot van?

conversation_starters.description: Animal control officers believe the dog was left unattended inside the car for nearly four hours while temperatures outside climbed into the 80s.
